channel.title: Rad Dolo — The Journal
channel.description: Notes on getting dressed, from Minneapolis personal stylist Rad Dolo.

item.title: Welcome to Rad's Journal
item.description: Start here: what this journal is, who I am, and where to begin.

item.title: Keep, donate, maybe
item.description: Every closet edit starts with three piles, keep, donate, maybe, and one rule that breaks every tie: if it "sort of fits," it goes.

item.title: Why getting dressed feels exhausting
item.description: A closet full of clothes and nothing to wear isn't a shopping problem. It's a decision problem.

item.title: Shop your closet first
item.description: The best styling session I ever had involved buying nothing. Start with what's already hanging there.

item.title: One suitcase, every day handled
item.description: People don't overpack because they own too much. They overpack because they haven't decided anything yet.

item.title: Worse than the dentist
item.description: You don't have to enjoy shopping. You just have to stop dreading your closet.
